verdict.rationale: Recruitee documents per-job hiring pipelines (stages) and generic templates for reuse, which covers only the stage-structure part of a reusable interview plan. Nothing in the evidence describes interview question banks, scorecards, or interviewer-specific focus areas. The job 'questions' in the API are application-form questions, not interview questions. Missing for 10: interview question banks, per-interviewer focus areas/scorecards, explicit reusable interview-plan templates per role, independent or hands-on corroboration.
